title: Split by person, a calculator keypad and smarter card reminders
summary: Pick who each split expense is for, type amounts on a built-in calculator, and get credit card reminders that ease off once you've paid.

sections.title: Split expenses
items: Choose who each expense is for: untick whoever wasn't there and the rest share it
Expenses for only some people say who they were for, and settle-up shows how each share adds up
Sub-groups you already made keep working; costs for a few people are now picked on the expense itself
Editing an expense no longer opens the keyboard

sections.title: Add record
items: Type the amount on a calculator keypad: add, subtract, multiply or divide, and the result is saved
Hold delete to clear, and the amount never goes below zero

sections.title: Credit cards
items: Reminders on the days that matter: your first reminder day, then every day for the last three days
Paid the minimum? Reminders ease off to the day before and the due day
Paid in full? They stop until the next bill
Fixed: a card could keep reminding you every morning after the bill was paid
The minimum due now counts part payments

sections.title: Accounts
items: Choose whether archived accounts count in your total balance

sections.title: Backup
items: Fixed: weekly and monthly automatic Drive backups could stop at 70% and retry again and again
A new Drive backup replaces the old one only after it has uploaded
If Google Drive needs you to sign in again, you get one clear notice

sections.title: Also new
items: Update notifications open Google Play directly and skip phones that are already up to date

title: Credit cards, account groups and import
summary: Track credit card bills and due dates, group and archive your accounts, and bring in your history from an Excel or CSV file.

sections.title: Credit cards
items: Add a card's bill and due dates to see the bill to pay, the minimum due and how much limit is left
Get a reminder before the due date until the bill is paid
Paying the bill is saved as a transfer from your bank, so the spends aren't counted twice

sections.title: Accounts
items: Group accounts, like Bank, FDs or Credit cards, with a total for each group
Archive an account you no longer use: its records and balance stay
New account types: UPI, Savings, Deposit (FD/RD), Investment and Loan

sections.title: Import
items: Import records from an Excel or CSV file, including Money Manager exports
Check the columns and review new accounts and categories before anything is saved
Importing the same file again skips the records already there

sections.title: Notifications
items: One Notifications screen to turn the daily reminder, recurring records, card bills, budget alerts and backup notices on or off

sections.title: Split expenses
items: Settle up by UPI ID: UPI apps now block payment links between people
Pay links open on the PennyLog website, and shared summaries number each payment

sections.title: Also new
items: A new first-time setup that ends with a summary of what you set
Lists and sheets no longer go under the navigation bar

title: One People list and tappable charts
summary: The people you tag on expenses and the people in your split groups are now one list, and the Statistics charts open the records behind them.

sections.title: People and split expenses
items: One People list: the people you tag and the people in split groups are now the same
New split groups start with you in them
Shared summaries show your name instead of "Me"
An expense's description is now optional

sections.title: Statistics
items: Tap a category slice, a weekly bar or a day to see its records
Filter records from Statistics too

sections.title: Fixes and smaller changes
items: Recurring reminders stay until you add or skip
A short confirmation when you add, update or delete an account or category
Fixed PDF and Excel export on older phones, and a few crashes

title: Recurring records
summary: Set rent, salary or a subscription to repeat, and PennyLog adds it for you or asks on the day.

sections.title: Recurring records
items: Set any record to repeat: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or every few days
Add each repeat automatically, or get a notification on the due day with Add and Skip buttons
Repeats missed while the app was closed are added the next time you open it
A Recurring screen shows your monthly ins and outs and what's due this week

sections.title: Fixes
items: Show or hide amounts while a filter is on
The daily reminder keeps working after a phone restart
Fixed a few crashes and a tab flicker in light mode

title: People tags and backups that keep up
summary: Tag who an expense was for and see what each person cost you, and automatic Google Drive backups now catch up when your phone skips one.

sections.title: People tags
items: Mark who an expense was for: you, Mom, a friend or anyone you add
A People screen shows how much went to each person this month, with a category breakdown
Filter the dashboard by person, category or account
Statistics splits each expense category by person, and Excel exports gain a "For" column
Tags are labels only: they never change balances, budgets or split groups

sections.title: Backup
items: Daily, weekly and monthly Google Drive backups now catch up when the phone skips one
Choosing a backup frequency backs up straight away if there's no recent backup
The Backup screen now shows when the last automatic backup ran

title: Sub-groups and a quicker + button
summary: Split costs between just some of the people in a group, and start any record or a split bill straight from the + button.

sections.title: Split expenses
items: New sub-groups: track costs that only some people in a group shared, like a cab for three out of five
Each sub-group keeps its own expenses and who paid for them
Sub-group costs are settled together with the main group in Who pays whom

sections.title: Dashboard
items: The + button now opens a menu: Expense, Income, Transfer or Split a bill
Income and Transfer open straight on their own tab
Split a bill from the dashboard: add it to an open group or start a new one

title: A complete redesign
summary: Every screen has been rebuilt with a new design: new fonts, colourful category icons, and refreshed light and dark themes. Your records, accounts and budgets carry over as they are.

sections.title: Dashboard
items: Cleaner balance card with this month's income and expense
Records grouped by day, with an optional total beside each date
Record details, display options and confirmations now open as sheets
The + button tucks away while you scroll and comes back when you scroll up

sections.title: Add record
items: Amounts format as you type (1,24,560.50) and show in red or green
Choose the account and category from quick picker sheets
A transfer can't use the same account on both sides

sections.title: Statistics
items: New Categories, Trend and Accounts tabs
Category donut chart, monthly bar charts and a daily spending calendar
Tap a month in Trend to jump straight to it
Daily averages count only the days that have passed

sections.title: Budgets
items: New Past budgets view: how much you spent against your budget each month
"Almost used", "Limit reached" and "Over budget" labels on every category
Budget templates show their monthly total
The Set budget sheet shows last month's spend as a guide

sections.title: Accounts
items: New Wallet account type, alongside Bank, Cash, Card and Other
Each account type has its own colour throughout the app
Opening balances can be negative, for a card you owe on

sections.title: Categories
items: Pick a colour for any category
40+ new expense and income icons

sections.title: Split expenses
items: Redesigned groups, with Active and Settled sections
See what each person paid, gets back or owes, and expand to see their expenses
New "Who pays whom" screen with UPI pay links and QR codes
Show QR so a friend can pay you face to face
Refreshed shareable summary images

sections.title: Settings and data
items: Redesigned Preferences, Theme, Export, Backup & restore and Delete & reset screens
Refreshed PDF report layout
Delete & reset now asks you to type to confirm

title: Updates to 1.0
summary: The small releases between the first version and 2.0. They weren't written up at the time, so these notes are put together from the app's development history, month by month.

sections.title: September 2025
items: Statistics: an income and expense flow chart, and a bar chart for each account

sections.title: October 2025
items: Budgets: set a monthly limit for a category and see what is left
Backup and restore, so your records can move to a new phone
Export your records to a file
Delete and reset, to start over

sections.title: November 2025
items: A refreshed look for several screens

sections.title: February 2026
items: Split expenses: create a group, split bills between people and share the result as an image

sections.title: May 2026
items: Split expenses: save people once and reuse them across groups
A UPI QR code for each payment, so friends can settle up by scanning

sections.title: September 2026
items: Budget templates: save a month's limits and apply them to another month

sections.title: October 2026
items: UPI pay links alongside the QR codes when settling up

title: PennyLog is on Google Play
summary: The first public version: a simple, offline way to write down where your money goes.

sections.title: Records
items: Log expenses, income and transfers between your own accounts
Everything is saved on your phone and works without internet

sections.title: Accounts and categories
items: Keep cash, bank and wallet balances separately
Add your own income and expense categories with icons

sections.title: Statistics
items: See your spending by category in a chart

sections.title: Settings
items: Pick your currency when you start
A daily reminder to log the day's spending
Light and dark themes
